login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your institution account to continue.

onboarding.title: Verify your identity
onboarding.subtitle: We need a photo of your identity document to complete your profile.

camera.instructions: Place your document inside the frame and avoid glare.
camera.denied: We could not access the camera. Allow access in your browser or upload an image.
camera.unavailable: We could not find a camera on this device. You can upload an image.

confirm.title: Confirm your details
confirm.subtitle: We read these details from your document. Check them and correct anything that is wrong.

submitted.title: Application submitted
submitted.body: Your institution will review your details. We will let you know when your account is active.

errors.fallback: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account has been suspended. Contact your institution.
errors.GOOGLE_OAUTH_UNAVAILABLE: Google sign-in is not available right now.
errors.GOOGLE_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Your Google account email is not verified.
errors.GOOGLE_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Google sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
errors.INVALID_OAUTH_STATE: Google sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT_IMAGE: The photo must be a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.DOCUMENT_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The photo is too large. The maximum is 5 MB.
errors.HTTP_413: The photo is too large. The maximum is 5 MB.
errors.OCR_PROCESSING_FAILED: We could not read your document. Take another photo in good light.
errors.INVALID_BIRTH_DATE: The date of birth is not valid.
errors.NOTHING_TO_CONFIRM: Take a photo of your document first.
errors.HTTP_400: Check the details and try again.
